title: Scalar slow-W causal mediation shadow before operator-valued semantic W

hypothesis.primary: On a fresh frozen cohort, W_FULL_LEARNED improves utility over one development-selected strongest baseline by at least 0.05 with paired cluster-bootstrap LCB95 greater than zero.
hypothesis.mediation: Exact W removal and within-stratum W shuffle each erase at least 70 percent of learned gain, while exact W restoration recovers at least 90 percent and is equivalent to FULL inside a plus or minus 0.02 ROPE.
hypothesis.representation: Embedding-only, hypergraph-only, uniform-L1, random-update, and equal-information context/vector controls do not explain the FULL effect.
hypothesis.actuation: At least one fresh case changes a pre-LLM route under removal or shuffle, while exact restoration recovers the FULL numeric route digest.
hypothesis.retention: Old-regime retention loss is at most 0.03 and negative-transfer rate is at most 0.10.
hypothesis.interpretation_limit: Passing supports only causal efficacy of the implemented durable scalar W projection; it does not support operator-valued W, topology learning, transfer, consolidation, or larger-AI claims.

testbed.cohort_rule: new component-disjoint worlds never used by F1 sealed-r1, r2, or r3 and frozen before any measurement
testbed.sample_size_rule: paired development variance must establish at least 0.80 power for an absolute 0.05 effect before machine lock
testbed.freshness_identity: world content SHA-256 plus entity, relation, program, template, and near-duplicate exclusion manifest

intervention_sequences.assignment: balance the remove-first and shuffle-first sequences by hash(component_id, preregistration_seed) and counterbalance non-intervention arm positions with a frozen Latin square
intervention_sequences.carryover_control: distinct request ids, cache_hits=0, no hidden session state, and exact W mount receipt before every arm

arm_construction.W_FULL_LEARNED: mount the approved immutable W1 snapshot derived from W0 and pre-outcome eligibility-bound DeltaW
arm_construction.W_REMOVED_BASE: mount exact W0; never synthesize an all-zero ell field
arm_construction.W_SHUFFLED_WITHIN_STRATUM: force a derangement of DeltaW inside frozen relation-type, role-signature, arity, degree, and candidate-size strata while preserving the delta multiset and L1/L2 norms
arm_construction.W_RESTORED_EXACT: remount the original W1 bytes and require identical snapshot SHA, pre-LLM logits, rank, probabilities, and route digest
arm_construction.W_UNIFORM_L1_MATCHED: distribute matched update mass over identical support without semantic credit assignment
arm_construction.W_RANDOM_UPDATE_MATCHED: use a preregistered seed to match support and magnitude distribution while destroying source assignment
arm_construction.STRONG_CONTEXT_VECTOR_EQUAL_INFO: serialize the same learned numeric information content through the strongest development-selected non-W representation under the same active-byte cap

metrics_and_thresholds.learned_gain: FULL minus frozen development-selected strongest baseline; mean at least 0.05 and paired cluster-bootstrap LCB95 greater than zero
metrics_and_thresholds.full_over_embedding_delta: FULL minus EMBEDDING_ONLY; paired cluster-bootstrap LCB95 greater than zero
metrics_and_thresholds.full_over_hypergraph_delta: FULL minus HYPERGRAPH_ONLY; paired cluster-bootstrap LCB95 greater than zero
metrics_and_thresholds.w_ablation_delta: FULL minus REMOVED; paired LCB95 greater than zero
metrics_and_thresholds.w_shuffle_delta: FULL minus SHUFFLED; paired LCB95 greater than zero
metrics_and_thresholds.w_random_update_delta: FULL minus RANDOM_UPDATE; paired LCB95 greater than zero
metrics_and_thresholds.context_operator_delta: FULL minus STRONG_CONTEXT_VECTOR; mean at least 0.03 and paired LCB95 greater than zero
metrics_and_thresholds.removal_erasure_fraction: (FULL-REMOVED)/(FULL-strongest_baseline) at least 0.70 when denominator is positive
metrics_and_thresholds.shuffle_erasure_fraction: (FULL-SHUFFLED)/(FULL-strongest_baseline) at least 0.70 when denominator is positive
metrics_and_thresholds.random_update_erasure_fraction: (FULL-RANDOM_UPDATE)/(FULL-strongest_baseline) at least 0.70 when denominator is positive
metrics_and_thresholds.restoration_gap: FULL minus RESTORED paired interval entirely inside [-0.02,0.02]
metrics_and_thresholds.route_jsd_normalized: macro mean JSD(pi_FULL||pi_intervention)/ln(2), with at least one route-divergent fresh case
metrics_and_thresholds.route_case_count: number of fresh FULL rows independently eligible for route-divergence comparison
metrics_and_thresholds.route_divergence_cases: fresh FULL rows whose removal or shuffle route JSD exceeds 1e-12; at least one and never greater than route_case_count
metrics_and_thresholds.retention_loss: strongest-baseline retention minus FULL retention at most 0.03
metrics_and_thresholds.negative_transfer_rate: fraction of fresh clusters with harmful FULL effect at most 0.10
metrics_and_thresholds.seed_direction: at least four of five independent seeds have positive learned-gain direction

statistics.within_cluster: macro mean across items before resampling
statistics.resampling: paired percentile bootstrap with 10000 samples and frozen seed
statistics.strongest_baseline_selection: select exactly one of FROZEN_NO_WRITE, STRONG_CONTEXT_VECTOR_EQUAL_INFO, or W_UNIFORM_L1_MATCHED on development only and freeze its SHA before fresh evaluation
statistics.multiple_views: utility, route actuation, retention, and negative transfer are reported separately and cannot compensate for a failed primary seam

firewalls.eligibility: append-only receipt sealed before independent numeric reward
firewalls.gold: answer and route receipts sealed before gold release
firewalls.language: training answer, verdict, rationale, and natural-language lesson are forbidden from W updates and later prompts
firewalls.identity: edge ids, tuple ids, candidate order, prompt strings, and cache keys cannot reveal world identity
firewalls.cohort: F1 sealed items and any exposed development item are forbidden
firewalls.hashes: any post-lock change to model, prompt, tokenizer, function registry, topology, embedding, relation schema, candidate universe, W builder, metric reducer, or judge voids the run

kill_conditions: learned gain is below 0.05 or paired LCB95 is not greater than zero
the development-selected strongest baseline matches or exceeds FULL
NO_SHARED_STATE, EMBEDDING_ONLY, HYPERGRAPH_ONLY, W_UNIFORM_L1_MATCHED, W_RANDOM_UPDATE_MATCHED, or STRONG_CONTEXT_VECTOR_EQUAL_INFO matches or exceeds FULL under its preregistered paired gate
removal or shuffle erases less than 70 percent of a positive learned gain
random matched updates explain the effect
exact W1 restoration fails or restored behavior is outside the frozen equivalence ROPE
no pre-LLM route or selected bond changes under two independent intervention attempts
the effect disappears under fresh relation or entity paraphrases
void_conditions: model, compute envelope, raw-information union, topology, embedding, relation schema, task, candidate universe, or state-capacity parity fails
eligibility is created or mutated after independent reward observation
answer, verdict, rationale, or natural-language lesson leaks into a later prompt or W update
fresh cohort overlaps F1, development, training, or a near-duplicate surface
shuffle changes support, type, role, arity, degree stratum, delta multiset, L1 norm, or L2 norm
restored snapshot SHA or deterministic route digest differs from FULL
any measurement-affecting artifact changes after machine lock
producer and independent judge receipts are not distinct
injected-negative validation does not fail closed
required_before_lock: explicit user ratification of this exact draft or a successor hash
F1 sealed-r3 completion, independent adjudication, and active-tree readback
fresh dataset, split, candidate-universe, and near-duplicate manifest hashes
model endpoint, revision, tokenizer, prompt, function registry, and compute-envelope hashes
W0, W1, DeltaW, strata, shuffle permutation, random-update, and restoration manifest hashes
power receipt and five frozen independent seeds
independent pure-judge code and injected-negative fixtures
LakatoTree prediction registration and exact readback
